protocol.credit: one for final win including eliminator or bowl-out, half for unresolved tie/draw or post-toss no-result, zero for loss
protocol.eligibility: senior men's and women's international T20 matches with a contested toss; exclude Afghanistan coverage, youth teams and pre-toss cancellations
protocol.fit: five whole-event/season folds; arm-specific ridge alpha 1 with intercept; gender-specific focal and opponent, venue, gender, month, numeric year; predictions clipped to [0,1]; known-p AIPW
protocol.focal_team: alphabetically first of the two archived team names
protocol.intervention: fair toss awards choice of innings order to focal team
protocol.missing: require reconciliation with independent full fixture roster before final score; report provisional covered-sample estimate and worst-case bounds when matches unresolved
protocol.ranking: DML against half-history using paired squared error and transformed two-sided 95% target interval; quarterly estimates descriptive
protocol.score: mean centered randomized win-credit contrast; series-clustered t interval; fixed 28-day calendar-block sensitivity; later eligible matches receive equal weights
protocol.target: ITT of winning the right to choose innings order on the prespecified focal team's win credit
